figures.finding: Fiji's Employment Relations Act 2007 sets the minimum age for employment at fifteen (s. 92) and lets children of thirteen to fifteen do only light work that does not harm their health, development or education (s. 93), without listing the activities or capping the hours; hazardous work is barred below eighteen.
figures.applies: Fiji (as of 2024-2026; the Act's own text not reached: laws.gov.fj is a script application and PacLII blocks this client).

sources.said: Although the Employment Relations Promulgation includes a light work framework, it does not specify the activities or conditions in which light work may be undertaken or limit the number of hours for light work.
Mr Nemani said the Employment Relations Act 2007 permits children aged 13 to 15 years to perform only light work, provided it does not harm their health, development or education.

figures.finding: Under Fiji's Companies Act 2015 a director must be a natural person of at least eighteen (Expanship's guide; the Act's own text not reached), so a minor may hold shares in a producer's company but direct it only from eighteen.

sources.said: Minimum Age Requirement Directors must be at least 18 years of age.
